name: Brigade Insignia
config: 3 bed residences and 3, 4 & 5 BHK sky mansions
description: Six towers on about 5.9 acres along the airport road in Yelahanka, with 3 bed residences and larger sky mansions. The plan keeps a heritage tree plaza and adds sky gardens to the homes.
curation: Choice of 3 bed residences or 3 to 5 BHK sky mansions
Heritage tree plaza kept within the landscape
developerNote: Founded in 1986, Brigade Group is a publicly listed company on the NSE and BSE. Its portfolio spans residential, commercial, retail, and hospitality developments, from apartments and integrated enclaves to offices, malls, hotels, and schools.
